change_policy: Business definitions. Never overridden by environment variables. Any change needs a dated entry in docs/decisions_log.md and a version bump.

dc_charger.rule: charger_id has >=1 identified (non-blank) port whose max peak_power_kw across all sessions exceeds the threshold

unbound_attempts.definition: blank port_id on a DC charger
unbound_attempts.treatment: keep as an attempt; attribute to the charger's site

attempt.exact_duplicate_rows: an exact duplicate row (all columns identical) is export duplication: keep one, count and log
attempt.conflicting_duplicates: same session_id with different values is a FAIL (cannot choose silently)

site_resolution.step_1: charger -> AFDC record where any of the charger's non-blank port_id values is in ev_network_ids.posts
site_resolution.step_2: else fuzzy match of normalised evse_name (text with '/' replaced by a space) against normalised AFDC station_name using difflib, best match with ratio >= cutoff
site_resolution.normalisation: uppercase; keep A-Z, 0-9 and spaces; collapse repeated spaces; strip
site_resolution.step_3: else unresolved -> validation FAIL (every DC charger must have a site)
site_resolution.clustering: chargers whose matched AFDC coordinates are within max_distance_m of each other (single-linkage) form one physical site
site_resolution.why_distance_not_address: the registry spells some addresses differently for the same site (e.g. 'US-51' vs 'U.S. 51'); within-site distances are <= 33 m and the nearest separate site is 17 km away
site_resolution.site_id: S01..Snn assigned in order of the site's most common normalised address

visit.gap_definition: session_start minus the session_end of the previous row in sort order at the same site
visit.visit_success_rule: any attempt in the visit is successful

kpi.name: First-Time Charge Success rate (FTCS)
kpi.formula: visits whose first attempt succeeded / all visits
kpi.baseline_rule: the baseline_months most recent monthly exports present in the data, anchored to the end of the data (not the run date)

lagging_sites.rule: site FTCS is strictly more than 5.0 percentage points below the median site FTCS, compared on unrounded values

freshness.reporting_month: the calendar month before the logical run date
freshness.rule: latest session_start must be within max_lag_days of the end of the reporting month (FAIL otherwise)
freshness.why_2_days: every monthly export is missing its final calendar day (UTC), so up to ~1 day of lag is expected
freshness.wall_clock_age: age versus today's date is reported as WARN ('historical backfill'), never FAIL

validation_tolerances.note: Tolerances of the validation gate (D8). Kept here, not in code or env, so a change is versioned and logged.
validation_tolerances.why_energy_zero_tolerance: energy_kwh is the KPI input; a missing value would silently count as a failed attempt

outage_inference.rule: for a charger with share p (>= min_share) of the site's successful sessions, a run of k consecutive successful site sessions on other chargers is an inferred outage when (1-p)^k < probability_threshold
outage_inference.bounded_by: charger commissioned life (first to last session)

repair_effect.basis: illustrative - work-order timing is simulated; before/after comparison with no control group

trend.why: a charger whose first session is more than 14 days after the data starts was commissioned during the window (mix effect on trends)
